The '''Model 3 Imperial Army electrobinoculars''' were a model of [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]] produced by the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] for use providing optical enhancement to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. They were available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and cost 250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Model 3 Imperial Army electrobinoculars were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Sterling Hershey]].
